title: Flux

text.TAG: Place positive and negative charges, paint magnetic fields and fire particle beams. See the invisible forces that hold atoms together
text.FREE: An empty lab: every charge, emitter and magnet, no goals
text.WATCH: A tour of the fields: dipoles, beams bent by magnets and electrons orbiting a nucleus
text.FOOT: Like charges push apart, opposite charges pull together. Moving charges curve in a magnetic field.
text.FIND: Find a charge, emitter or tool…
text.HINT: Click to place · right-drag to look around
